text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
"Month X, Day X.
Finally, the day for Nakayama Festa's
challenge at the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe has arrived."

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa appears in the paddock.
Her body looks more robust than before her trip abroad, exuding an air of true dignity.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
The muscles in her legs have completely adapted to European standards.
She had announced an extended tour abroad this time, and it seems she was blessed with great training partners there.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
The cheers from the crowd were fervent as well.
Everyone truly believed that she would be the one to take first place.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
If I told this to myself from a year ago,
I'd probably be overjoyed that the time had finally come.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text: And if I were to tell this story to myself from two years ago—

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text: —People would surely be surprised to hear it was that Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
To us back then, the star was someone else.
Nakayama Festa stood out a little, but most considered her just one rough diamond among many.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
Her words back then were brushed off not as brave,
but as mere recklessness.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
Still, she honed and polished herself,
turning a dull glow into a singular, unmatched luster.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa, standing in the paddock,
was watched over by the Trainers.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
A woman dressed in traditional Japanese attire waved to her.
Nakayama Festa waved back in return.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
"She taught us
how to dream."

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
"She taught us
the courage to face the rough seas."

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
"She taught us
how to speak of romance."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"...Even the sun is blessing Festa's Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe,
isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Right! Yesterday's heavy rain was quite a surprise, though...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Still, thanks to the rain, the track is nice and damp!
Bad track conditions, my advantage, the key to victory! YEAAAH!!
choice_data_list: You're right, even the weather is on her side.
Yeah, the weather is on her side too.

text_block_list.text:
Until the day before yesterday, Paris had seen non-stop dry, sunny weather,
without the slightest hint of rain.

Nakayama Festa is much better on heavy ground
than on a firm, sunny track.
That's why the unexpected downpour was pure luck for her.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Then I'm sure you'll be able to take 1st place too!
choice_data_list: Yeah, definitely. She's going to make a miracle happen.
Yeah, absolutely. She's going to work a miracle.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: ...A miracle.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yes, this is a tale of miracles.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haha, spare me the lecture, alright? I'll head right back to the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer. Sensei.
And El and the others too."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Keep your eyes peeled.
You're about to witness history change.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. I'll see it through with my own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Haha.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
—I'm heading out.

And on this day,
a new page in history was written—
(Chirp, chirp chirp chirp...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama-san!
Please tell Dia more about the
"Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe"!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Dia-chan, no fair!
Senpai, I'm aiming for the world stage too!
Please give me some advice!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haaah... Go ask El for that kind of stuff.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
El is good at teaching.
...After all, she is my master.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohh~! The master's master!
What a fiery ring to it...!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, understood.
Then if El-san isn't around,
I'll try approaching her again♪

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Alright, alright, you too, milady. Off you go, off you go.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Pheeew...
choice_data_list: Seems you're pretty popular with your juniors, huh?
Seems you're quite popular with your juniors, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: It ain't popularity, they're just curious.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
An Uma Musume like me spread her wings and flew out into the world.
So I bet those little chicks figured they'd take flight too.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well, who knows about that~

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Whether I flew or not, there were always gonna be folks who couldn't be satisfied with just this tiny Japan.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: The romance of throwing yourself into a white-hot battle and leaving your mark will always be there.
choice_data_list: Even so, I think your influence definitely made a difference.
Even so, I'm sure your influence made a real difference.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Hah.
If that's what you want to say, go right ahead.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
However, it's far too early to set up a milestone
for posterity and call it a day.
Mind if I say at least that much?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer.
You haven't made the most out of me yet, have you?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, which race should we enter next?
Yeah, which race should we enter next?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, that's fine.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: It is the accumulation of each and every choice that shapes our present reality.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Still, we don't even know where our finish line is yet.
So stick with me till the very end, alright?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: We're going all the way to hell together, right?

Nakayama Festa smiles mischievously.
—If I run away here, it's my loss.
